newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan's Sharp plans second China production base.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Sharp plans second China production base.

text.p: Japan's Sharp Group plans to expand electronics manufacturing in China by setting up a second production base elsewhere in the country to complement its Shanghai operations, a company official said on Tuesday.
"China is, as you know, a large country," said Shanghai Sharp Electronics Co. Ltd. general manager for China business, Sadayoshi Mikuni. "The first stage production base is not enough."
Sharp currently has four joint ventures and a fully-owned company in China with total investment of around 30 billion yen, all based in or near Shanghai, he said.
"In 1999 or 2000, Sharp will have another production base ...," he told reporters.
The location has yet to be decided, but the northern part of China was the most likely, Mikuni said.

One of its joint ventures, Shanghai Sharp Electrical Equipment Co Ltd, on Tuesday received a 30-million-yuan loan from the Industrial & Commercial Bank of China and Japan's Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi to fund production of refrigerators and washing machines.
The venture,set up in 1992, sells 70 percent of its products on the local market and exports 30 percent, he said. Sales reached 1.5 billion yuan in 1996, according to a media release.
Mikuni said Sharp plans to add another factory in Shanghai in 1998 to produce equipment to make moldings, plastic casings for various electronics appliances.
Other Sharp group factories in the Shanghai area produce items including copying machines, laser printers and liquid crystal display (LCD) panels.
